author: RuneScape
title: The Making of Archaeology - RuneScape Weekly Stream (April 2020)
quote: [...] we had five skills that we had a shortlist down to, and they were Archaeology, Sailing, Spellcrafting, Animal Training and Merchanting. And... this was the first time that we sort of seriously considered these skills or seriously considering what the design of what this would look like in RuneScape.

author: RuneScape
title: The Making of Archaeology - RuneScape Weekly Stream (April 2020)
quote: There were six skills. Almost forgot about that. Archaeology was not the top skill. We came out of that meeting, four-hour meeting at the pub after a few beers, and Archaeology was not the top skill. The top skill was easily Necromancy.
name: top skill

author: RuneScape
title: The Making of Archaeology - RuneScape Weekly Stream (April 2020)
quote: [...] we had disregarded Necromancy from a design point of view because we didn't think there was much room for it. It sits too closely to Summoning and... either sits too close to Summoning or sits too close to Prayer or sits too close to Magic. And we weren't looking to make an elite skill. I know some people would be like "Why wouldn't you make an elite skill out of those three skills?", and just like... We didn't want this skill to be an elite skill; that was one of our aims. So we ended up disregarding Necromancy out of our top five.
